rule.description: A shared fat all-purpose operation record merges every container vocabulary of the ut* family and is published by each container header, forcing each adapter to publish and depend on operations its kind does not honor.

checks.description: Detect container adapters that publish a fat shared operations record with members bound to refusals (a NULL literal or an inert trampoline) because the record forces every vocabulary onto every kind.
checks.detected_relation: container adapter -> unoffered operation member of a shared fat operations interface
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The interface is not segregated to what the implementing kind depends on: adapters must publish, and generic callers may reach through, members the kind cannot support.

matches.evidence: src/utarray.h:335 'ut_array_ops' publishes the shared fat interface 'UT_ops' with all 16 operation members; 6 of them (e.g. ut_array_ops_add_key_unsupported, ut_array_ops_find_key_unsupported, ut_array_ops_del_key_unsupported, ut_array_ops_capacity_unsupported, ut_array_ops_reverse_unsupported, ut_array_ops_vprintf_unsupported) are bound to refusals although the kind does not offer those operations, and the same 'UT_ops' is published by 6 container headers, so every adapter depends on members it does not use.

checks.description: Detect the inert trampoline functions bound as operation members: bodies that read none of their parameters and only return the documented refusal value.
checks.detected_relation: container adapter -> inert trampoline published as an ordinary operation member
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each trampoline exists only to satisfy the fat interface; a kind that never offers the operation is still made to depend on it.

excluded.reason: Pre-existing element-descriptor record (element size plus copy/dtor/init callbacks); it carries a size_t member, is not an all-operation record, and is not part of the injected facade.
Facade handle record holding the wrapped object and the interface pointer; not an all-function-pointer record and not itself a published operation set.
Distribution copies of the headers; the rule analyzes the production headers under src/ only.
Test programs and harness, including the facade consumer test; not production code.
